news.title: Hellas Verona Foundation | End-of-Season Auction Now Live on MatchWornShirt

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam scale-up auctioning match-worn and signed shirts from 400+ clubs and leagues; an international team that hires English-speaking interns.

culture.text: About 124 staff describing themselves as an international team of sports fans, tech people and digital marketers.
Offices in Amsterdam, Dallas, Istanbul, Manchester and São Paulo, headquartered in Amsterdam.
Staff mostly come from Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, UvA, VU, Hogeschool Utrecht and The Hague University, studying marketing and international business.

open.text: All 3 current jobs here are Amsterdam internships (sales, marketing, finance) that don't require Dutch.
Its internships here draw about 69 LinkedIn applicants on average, so expect competition.

growth.text: Founded in 2017, it now has about 124 employees and partners with over 400 teams and leagues, including PSG, Manchester United and AC Milan.
QPR extended its partnership with MatchWornShirt for the 2026/27 season.

worth_knowing.text: A significant part of auction proceeds goes to club foundations and charities.
